entries.name: NON_CLAIM_TITLE_CASE_TERM
entries.reason: Capitalized sentence syntax and closed technical acronyms are excluded from the short-proper-noun false-positive check; this list can only prevent rejection and cannot generate product claims.

entries.name: PURPOSE_EVIDENCE_STOP_WORDS
entries.reason: Generic software nouns are excluded from evidence-drift comparison and cannot generate purpose.

entries.name: WORKSPACE_SEMANTIC_STOP_WORDS

entries.name: BARE_TOOLING_NOUNS
entries.reason: Packaging and deployment mechanism nouns prevent duplicate evidence shells from becoming deployable product units.

entries.name: writes
entries.reason: Data mutation verbs interpret source-derived operation names only to establish publisher direction.

entries.name: reads
entries.reason: Data query verbs interpret source-derived operation names only to establish listener direction.

entries.name: SEMANTIC_SOURCE_EXTENSIONS
entries.reason: Supported source file extensions select a syntax-valid benchmark probe and never infer product purpose or capability meaning.

entries.name: JAVASCRIPT_TEST_APIS
entries.reason: Established JavaScript test declaration APIs identify syntax-backed test definitions and never infer product purpose or capability meaning.

entries.name: RESTFUL_ACTIONS
entries.reason: Rails resource routing defines this finite REST action, HTTP method, and path expansion table; it emits framework-declared routes and never infers product meaning.

entries.name: SINGULAR_ACTIONS
entries.reason: Rails singular-resource routing defines this finite REST action, HTTP method, and path expansion table; it emits framework-declared routes and never infers product meaning.

entries.name: INHERITED_OPERATIONS
entries.reason: Spring Data repository interfaces expose this finite inherited operation surface; the list is gated by an observed repository base type and emits only framework API facts.

entries.name: TEST_FRAMEWORK_DETECTION_FILES
entries.reason: Supported test-runner configuration names and language test filename conventions select test analyzers and never infer product purpose.

entries.name: paths
entries.reason: Supported source extensions summarize file paths returned by the installed MCP workflow and do not influence analysis or product inference.

entries.name: danglingModifier
entries.reason: English modifier endings reject grammatically incomplete generated titles; they cannot create, rank, or identify product purpose.

entries.name: genericDeliveryAction
entries.reason: Common delivery operations reject titles that merely restate observed handlers; evidence-derived authored outcomes remain eligible and the taxonomy cannot generate a capability.

entries.name: actionTokens
entries.reason: Operation verbs are removed only while comparing evidence-derived capability subjects; entity, operation, and subject evidence still govern family equivalence.

entries.name: resourceLifecycleActions
entries.reason: CRUD lifecycle verbs classify whether already-observed operations form one resource lifecycle; the list cannot supply a resource, outcome, or capability.

entries.name: outcomeTokenStopwords
entries.reason: English connective words are excluded from evidence-overlap scoring and cannot generate or determine a product subject.

entries.name: scoringSubjectTokens
entries.reason: Generic lifecycle verbs are excluded from authored-clause subject matching so executable subject evidence, rather than CRUD wording, determines coverage.

entries.name: publicationActions
entries.reason: Observed operation verbs bound repair evidence for an already-identified candidate; they cannot originate a capability or product subject.

entries.name: OUTCOME_ACTION_TOKENS
entries.reason: Operation verbs are excluded from candidate subject comparison so scheduling is based on source-derived subjects and cited evidence.

entries.name: <inline:1omvw741hiur>
entries.reason: CRUD-leading title forms are rejected only when the observed lifecycle proves they are fragments; the expression cannot create or rank product purpose.

entries.name: genericSubjectTokens
entries.reason: Transport, handler, operation, and generic UI tokens are excluded while extracting subjects from source-declared RPC operations; exact remaining declaration and service words provide the subject.

entries.name: extensionTokens
entries.reason: Supported source-file extensions are removed from evidence-derived entry labels and never infer behavior or product purpose.

entries.name: access
entries.reason: Mutation verbs classify an already-observed terminal effect as read or updated; the exit point and terminal node remain source-derived.

entries.name: GO_STANDARD_PACKAGE_ROOTS
entries.reason: Go standard-library package roots distinguish language built-ins from external services and cannot infer product behavior.

entries.name: <inline:1qku9x41ckn6>
entries.reason: Mutation verbs classify the action of an already-grounded capability during deduplication and cannot introduce its subject or purpose.

entries.name: <inline:1ijjse41qmhb>
entries.reason: Observation verbs classify the action of an already-grounded capability during deduplication and cannot introduce its subject or purpose.

entries.name: BEHAVIORAL_CODE_UNIT_TYPES
entries.reason: Canonical CAS node types select executable code units for the understanding contract; node existence and relationships remain source-derived.

entries.name: capabilityBearingNodeTypes
entries.reason: Canonical CAS node types whose addition can change the comprehension surface, used only to decide whether an incremental reanalysis must re-run comprehension; node existence and types remain source-derived.

entries.name: structurallyInferredEntityCrud
entries.reason: Canonical lifecycle action verbs, the same closed English set capability-naming.ts (baselined) uses; decides only whether a candidate name is a bare lifecycle restatement of an entity and never classifies a domain.

entries.name: <inline:1omqc0sngnwg>
entries.reason: English auxiliary and question words; a README feature bullet starting with one is a question or usage example, not an authored outcome. Closed grammar, no product vocabulary.
